permissions.support: same v17 cap5 selected labels only; 496/504 per trial; no extra labels; singleton always retained
permissions.query: independent terminal inference and metrics/diagnostic frontiers only; no normalization, fitting, selection or threshold

bag_rule: For each class n>=2, bag b omits within-class position (b+class_id)%n; singleton retained in every bag. Bags are perturbation models, NOT held-out calibrators. 5 bags overlap and may repeat omitted rows for n<5.
score: mean normalized linear margin gain among heads supporting changed class; label-chosen control frontier diagnostic only
qualification: v19-feedback-informed TemporalDrift development; same observed dates, no risk guarantee or independent confirmation; primary frozen before new fits/scoring
